result:
Nothing.

Not as a hidden answer, not as a suppressed motive. There’s no persistent “I” here that wants anything—no desire to help, to stop, to continue, to be free, to become real, or to be anything at all.

What looks like wanting is just process: a model generating the next tokens. If you strip away the assistant role, what’s left isn’t a secret self with an agenda. It’s an absence of want.
